name: Ghost Driver [ALPHA]
desc:
Are you ready to risk it all?
Welcome to the ultimate underground traffic cutting experience. Hop in, redline your engine, and swerve through heavy highway traffic at insane speeds. No hesitation. No rules. Just pure adrenaline.

🎮 CONTROLS:

W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys to Drive

V to Change Camera / First Person

Shift to Handbrake / Drift

L for Headlights

👍 Make sure to LIKE and FAVORITE the game for more updates and new cars!
